newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends firm on technical buying.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends firm on technical buying.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended firmer after spillover strength from other U.S. wheat markets attracted late technical buying, traders said.

Hard red winter wheat futures in Kansas City received a late boost as cash basis bids surged eight cents. CBOT wheat also firmed amid improved prospects for a resumption of U.S. wheat sales to Turkey.
"We had stops hit in the March and Dec toward the close, and that brought in technical buying," a trader said.
MGE spring wheat settled one cent lower to 8-3/4 cents higher, with Dec up 8-3/4 cent at $3.94.

Traders said there had been little flat-price activity during Friday's session, although the December/March spread had traded actively. It widened to 15-1/2 cents per bushel late in the session after opening at around 13 cents.

Traders said Chicago Corp bull-spread one million Dec/March bushels at 13 to 13-1/2 cents. Atwood/Peavey bear-spread two million March/Dec in the same range. Atwood/Peavey also bought 800,000 Dec bushels, much of it late in the session.
One trader said LFG was a key scale-up seller all session, shedding two million March bushels as the market rallied.
MGE barley futures closed unchanged to five cents per cwt higher, with the Dec being offered unchanged at $6.42.
